mapper.select: SELECT model_version_id FROM model_versions WHERE model_name = #{modelName} AND version_label = #{versionLabel}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO model_versions (model_name, version_label, execution_type, description) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{versionLabel}, 'ML', '재무 진단 추천 서버 (FastAPI)')
INSERT INTO input_snapshots (user_id, status_code, submitted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, 'SUBMITTED', NOW())
INSERT INTO financial_profiles (snapshot_id, monthly_net_income, monthly_living_expense, available_cash) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{monthlyExpense}, #{purchaseFunds})

INSERT INTO analysis_runs (snapshot_id, model_version_id, status_code, monthly_available_amount, recommended_price_max, completed_at) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{modelVersionId}, 'COMPLETED', #{monthlyAvailable}, #{priceUpper}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.analysis_id, a.completed_at, f.monthly_net_income AS monthly_income, a.monthly_available_amount AS monthly_available, f.available_cash AS purchase_funds, a.recommended_price_max AS price_upper FROM analysis_runs a JOIN input_snapshots s ON s.snapshot_id = a.snapshot_id LEFT JOIN financial_profiles f ON f.snapshot_id = a.snapshot_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status_code = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY a.completed_at DESC, a.analysis_id DESC LIMIT #{size}
